Appendix 7
APPENDIX 7
ALL THAT HASHEM DOES IS GOOD
FAQ: “Do for us good acts of kindness.” What does that 
mean? Are there “bad” acts of kindness?
All that Hashem does for us is good for us. But there are sweet, tasty medicines and bitter medicines! They are both good for us, but we certainly would prefer the sweet one! Similarly, we ask Hashem that the acts of kindness He does for us should be sweet and pleasant, rather than harsh and bitter. Similarly, on Rosh Hashanah, we wish everyone, “
— A good and sweet year.” Why “sweet”? Because of course it will be a good year; all that Hashem does is good! But we wish our friends that the good Hashem does for them will be a “sweet good.”
